title: Certify, Then Repair: Exact Worst-Case Guarantees for Recurrent Policies Trained Against Strong Teachers
description: Code, data and paper for an exact worst-case certification and repair method for history-dependent policies trained against optimal teachers. The repository contains the Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Three, 4x4 Connect Four, 7x6 endgame and hidden-type Rock-Paper-Scissors experiments, the independent verifiers, and the LaTeX source of the paper.
